quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on the Pistons' strong start to the season
quotes.excerpt: We're not getting ahead of ourselves. The togetherness is there. We got a great system.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Cade, 3-0 to start the season, 3 Eastern Conference wins. What impressed you most about the way that this team has started the season?

text_blocks.speaker: Cade Cunningham
text_blocks.text: We just stay steady. We're not getting ahead of ourselves. The togetherness is there. We got a great system. We got the best coach in the league, so just trying to execute best we can and play together.

quotes.social_post: Cade Cunningham credits the Pistons early success to team chemistry and coaching saying we just stay steady and we are not getting ahead of ourselves

structured.context: Cade Cunningham discusses the team's undefeated start to the season and their collective mindset.

quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on team depth and stepping up in key moments
quotes.excerpt: Everybody had to step up, you know, bring a little extra intensity, a little extra effort.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: You looked comfortable out there really taking opportunities as they came to you. You weren't forcing anything. What was working for you out there?

text_blocks.speaker: Cade Cunningham
text_blocks.text: Just being aggressive. Obviously missing two huge parts of our team, JD and AT, so everybody had to step up, you know, bring a little extra intensity, a little extra effort, and we did a great job of that.

quotes.social_post: Cade Cunningham says the Pistons are leaning on collective effort while missing key players JD and AT noting that everyone had to step up and bring extra intensity

structured.context: Cade Cunningham explains how the team is adjusting to the absences of Jalen Duren and Ausar Thompson.

quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on maintaining momentum heading into the New York game
quotes.excerpt: We're just trying to stack days, getting better and better each day.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: We got New York on Tuesday, obviously the reigning NBA champions. How do you take a win like this, use it as motivation going into New York, another tough environment?

text_blocks.speaker: Cade Cunningham
text_blocks.text: We're just trying to stack days, getting better and better each day. Today was a great one, we got to put it behind us, we're already onto the next one and trying to prepare and get the job done out there.

quotes.social_post: Looking ahead to a matchup against the reigning champion Knicks Cade Cunningham says the Pistons are focused on stacking days and getting better each day

structured.context: Cade Cunningham addresses the upcoming game against the New York Knicks.
